input.value: fire on stove from grease flare-up while sauteing onions, extinguished with fire extinguisher
charred kitchen cabinets above stove and smoke damage on ceiling and walls

input.rationale: Fire and smoke damage to the claimant's own kitchen cabinets, ceiling, and walls caused by an accidental grease fire—a direct loss to the claimant's property covered under property damage.

Structural damage to kitchen cabinets and smoke damage to multiple surfaces represents moderate property loss, but the fire was contained to one room, no injuries occurred, and the rest of the house was unaffected.

input.claim_summary: Policy POL-1001 (Alex Doe, homeowners, active): Grease fire in kitchen caused by sauteing incident yesterday evening. Claimant extinguished fire with fire extinguisher. Damage includes charred kitchen cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls. No injuries. Deductible $500, coverage limit $250,000. Classified as property_damage with 0.95 confidence. Severity: medium—moderate loss to kitchen surfaces contained to one room with no injuries or rest-of-home damage.
